    SmallMarket stall fruit skewers with honey dipStrawberry, rockmelon, kiwi and grape skewers with honey yoghurt dipHow to make it250g strawberries1/4 rockmelon2 kiwi fruits250g grapes250g Greek yoghurt2 tbsp honey1 tsp vanilla extract30g shredded coconutHull the strawberries, cube the rockmelon, peel and cube the kiwi fruit and pick the grapes.Thread onto skewers in rainbow order.Mix the yoghurt with honey and vanilla.Toast the coconut in a dry pan until golden.Serve the skewers with the yoghurt dip and the coconut for dipping and rolling.Dried fruit heist crunch mixBaked honey oat clusters with almonds, seeds and dried fruit. Lasts forever.How to make it100g rolled oats100g almonds50g pumpkin seeds3 tbsp honey1 tbsp vegetable oil1 tsp ground cinnamon80g dried apricots60g dried apple60g dried cranberriesMix the oats, almonds and pumpkin seeds with honey, oil and cinnamon.Spread on a lined tray and press flat.Bake at 160°C, stirring once.Cool completely so it clusters.Break up and toss with chopped dried apricots, dried apple and dried cranberries.BigGloucester chicken, leek and bacon pieChicken, leek and bacon. Maybe he really is a bad seedHow to make it3 rashers of bacon800g chicken thigh fillets2 leeks2 carrots3 tbsp plain flour400ml chicken stock150ml thickened cream1 bunch of thyme1 sheet puff pastry1 egg300g frozen peas20g butterDice the bacon, chicken, leeks and carrots.Fry the bacon, then add the chicken and brown.Add the leeks and carrots and cook.Stir in the flour.Add the stock, cream and thyme and simmer.Pour into a pie dish, top with the pastry and brush with egg.Bake at 200°C until golden.Toss the peas in butter and serve alongside.Thomas McGregor's Windermere lamb hotpotBack from the honeymoon, before Bea's book dealHow to make it800g lamb shoulder, diced2 onions, sliced3 carrots, sliced2 tbsp plain flour500ml beef stock1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce4 sprigs of thyme800g potatoes, thinly sliced40g butter400g frozen peasHeat the oven to 170°C.
